evidence.quote: When you use the Service, we may generate data about your use of the Service, which may include your browser and device data, log data, and IP address.
evidence.heading: Information We Collect

G1.rationale: Duolingo collects personal data beyond basic contact details, including device data, log data, IP addresses, and audio recordings.

evidence.quote: Duolingo may process and share your personal information for the purpose of providing you with personalized advertising.
evidence.heading: How We Process Your Information

evidence.quote: You can opt out of receiving personalized advertising within the app Settings.
evidence.heading: How We Process Your Information

G2.rationale: The policy discloses sharing personal data with advertising networks for targeted ads, but provides a first-party opt-out setting in the app.

evidence.quote: Duolingo may process and share your personal information for the purpose of providing you with personalized advertising.
evidence.heading: How We Process Your Information

evidence.quote: You can opt out of receiving personalized advertising within the app Settings.
evidence.heading: How We Process Your Information

G3.rationale: Duolingo profiles users for targeted advertising and content personalisation, while offering first-party user controls in the app settings.

evidence.quote: To ensure your account stays operational, Duolingo will generally retain your personal information until your account is deleted.
evidence.heading: Data Retention

G4.rationale: Account data and general personal information are retained until account deletion or for operational necessity, while specific time limits are stated only for log/IP data.

evidence.quote: Request that we delete any personal information we have collected from you.
evidence.heading: Your Data Subject Rights

evidence.quote: Request that we correct any inaccurate personal information about you.
evidence.heading: Your Data Subject Rights

evidence.quote: You may request to access or erase your personal information and delete your account at the Duolingo Data Vault.
evidence.heading: Your Data Subject Rights

G5.rationale: Duolingo explicitly provides access, correction, and deletion rights to users generally via settings and the Duolingo Data Vault.

evidence.quote: Duolingo may transfer the data of users outside the United States to the United States.
evidence.heading: Data Transfer

evidence.quote: Duolingo complies with the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (EU-U.S. DPF), the UK Extension to the EU-U.S. DPF, and the Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (Swiss-U.S. DPF) as set forth by the U.S. Department of Commerce.
evidence.heading: Data Transfer

G6.rationale: Personal data is transferred internationally to the US, and specific transfer mechanisms (such as the Data Privacy Framework) are named.

evidence.quote: Duolingo treats Child Users (meaning users under the age of 13 in the United States or another age of digital consent in their country) differently to ensure their parents are in control and we only collect the bare minimum information we need to make Duolingo work.
evidence.heading: Child Users

G7.rationale: Child privacy protections are defined around an under-13 or local digital consent threshold without specific safeguards covering all minors under 18.

evidence.quote: Additionally, Duolingo may generate, record, and store audio recordings or transcripts of the text and audio you submit, and use these recordings or transcripts for product improvement and personalization purposes, including training and running Duolingo’s own artificial intelligence models.
evidence.heading: Information We Collect

evidence.quote: You may also choose not to share your audio with us for product improvement purposes within the app Settings.
evidence.heading: Information We Collect

AI1.rationale: Duolingo uses audio and text submissions to train AI models, but allows users to opt out of audio sharing via app settings.

evidence.quote: You may also choose not to share your audio with us for product improvement purposes within the app Settings.
evidence.heading: Information We Collect

AI2.rationale: Users can stop the use of their audio data for model training via a self-serve setting in the app.

evidence.quote: Duolingo may scan or review any Public Profile Information, or share your Public Profile Information with a third-party content moderation service provider, to ensure compliance with our Community Guidelines.
evidence.heading: Information We Collect

AI3.rationale: Human review of user profiles is restricted to content moderation and community guidelines compliance.

evidence.quote: Duolingo may anonymize your personal information, and use this de-identified data for any purpose, such as better understanding learning trends and training artificial intelligence models.
evidence.heading: How We Process Your Information

AI4.rationale: The policy states that de-identified data can be used for any purpose, including training artificial intelligence models.

evidence.quote: When you interact with Video Call or other AI-enabled features, the text and audio you submit may be shared with AI vendors such as OpenAI and Google.
evidence.heading: Information We Collect

evidence.quote: Duolingo’s agreements with these AI vendors mean they are not permitted to use any personal information for their own purposes.
evidence.heading: Information We Collect

AI5.rationale: User content shared with third-party AI vendors (e.g. OpenAI and Google) is restricted by contract, preventing them from using it for their own purposes.

evidence.quote: By using the Service, you agree with Duolingo’s collection, use, and sharing of your personal information in accordance with the terms of this Privacy Policy.
evidence.heading: General

DPDP1.rationale: Consent is collected using browsewrap language ('By using the Service, you agree...').

evidence.quote: Withdraw any consent you previously gave us to process your personal information.
evidence.heading: Your Data Subject Rights

evidence.quote: To make another privacy-related request, please send an email to privacy@duolingo.com.
evidence.heading: Your Data Subject Rights

DPDP2.rationale: General consent withdrawal requires submitting a privacy request via email.

evidence.quote: For all data privacy inquiries and any questions or concerns you have about this Privacy Policy, please contact our Data Protection Officer at privacy@duolingo.com.
evidence.heading: United Kingdom

DPDP3.rationale: The policy designates a Data Protection Officer and provides a direct contact email address.

DPDP4.rationale: The policy contains no statement regarding the availability of the privacy notice in Eighth Schedule Indian languages.
